youtube.baslik: Does a bone-conduction device sound better implanted than on a band? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: As vibration passes through skin and soft tissue, it can lose up to about 10 to 20 decibels, especially at high frequencies; this loss occurs in passive transcutaneous systems and in trials with the device worn on a band. In percutaneous systems, vibration goes directly to the bone, so a band trial often makes the sound after implantation seem a little worse than it will really be.
